title: Levuvo SF gate report (B4, GB4.1-GB4.3, R5)
description: Written by the factory only, from its own gate runs (JUnit XML for tests, SARIF for findings). Bound to commit, spec version, scenario-set version and gate-policy version; any change makes it outdated (G5.2). The complete report is factory-internal. Mode skeleton (A5) is bound to the PRD and architecture baseline, DoD and gate policy; it has no feature, spec, scenario set or acceptance criteria. The builder gets a separate factory-generated, deterministic view: per failed AC only the AC ID, the criterion text and the failure class (no free text); hidden test IDs, code, paths, fixtures, data and raw traces never appear in it (GB2.3). Every gate comes from the active gate policy and is derived from a DoD item (G4.2).

mode.description: feature = B4 for a feature or a part-C fix; skeleton = A5.

report_id.description: Part C: the bug report this run belongs to (C3); feature_id and spec_version are then the affected feature and its current spec version.

main_commit.description: main the PR was merged onto for the check (G5.4).

gate_config_sha256.description: Hash of the stack profile's gate_config files as used in this run (G8.2); set by the factory.

regression_manifest_version.description: Version of the factory's regression manifest (hidden sets of all done features, GB4.5) the hidden-test gate ran with; set by the factory.

tested_tree.description: Git tree hash of the merge result the gates ran on; the factory merges only a result with exactly this tree (G5.5, GB7.2).

scenario_set_version.description: Hidden scenario set the hidden tests came from (GB2.5).

round.description: Gate fix round; counted separately from review rounds, limit is a setting (R4).

name.description: E.g. build, lint, visible-tests, hidden-tests, secret-scan, vulnerability-scan, license, ac-coverage, conventional-commits.

result_file.description: Path in the factory's result store.

visible_tests.description: Visible test names that reference this AC.

hidden_tests.description: IDs only; shown to the builder never, to the reviewer yes.

feature_id.description: Set when the AC belongs to another done feature (regression, GB4.5).

failure_class.description: Derived deterministically from the JUnit failure; the only failure detail in the builder view besides AC ID and criterion text (GB4.6).

message.description: Raw failure message, factory-internal; never shown to the builder.
